Counsel for Respondent :- Archit Mandhyan,C.S.C.,Prateek Kumar
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Kshitij Shailendra,J.
1.

The instant petition has been filed praying for a writ of mandamus commanding the respondent authorities to pay compensation to the petitioners pursuant to award dated 24.02.1989 passed under the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 and for a further direction to the respondent authorities to decide their application dated 07.03.2020 moved by their brother in relation to payment of compensation amount to the petitioners.

sentences.text: The case of the petitioners is that their land comprising of Gata No.43, measuring one bigha, 18 biswa, was acquired by the State for the benefit of Krishi Utpadan Mandi Samiti in pursuance of notification under Section 6 of the Act dated 23.05.1988, which was followed by an award dated 24.02.1989.
There has been a family settlement between the petitioners and the private respondents, who are other family members, and the same has taken shape of an award, filed as Annexure No.6.
Thereunder, the petitioners claim exclusive right to the compensation amount.
Krishi Utpadan Mandi Samiti had filed a writ petition bearing No.16554 of 1990 challenging the award dated 24.02.1989 on the ground that it did not have requisite funds to make the payment.

The writ petition was dismissed by a Division Bench of this Court by order dated 09.11.2016 and the said judgment and order was upheld by the Supreme Court by dismissing Special Leave Petition filed by the Krishi Utpadan Mandi Samiti.
The petitioners have not been paid compensation despite dismissal of the writ petition filed by Krishi Utpadan Mandi Samiti and the SLP by the Supreme Court.
3. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of Krishi Utpadan Mandi Samiti is in receipt of instructions and the same is taken on record.
According to it, a sum of Rs.1,17,11,558/- was released for payment of compensation amount to the affected persons on 17.02.2020.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that although the amount was purportedly released in the month of February, 2020 but the Special Land Acquisition Officer on 07.03.2020 disclosed that compensation for one bigha land was paid to Giriraj Singh, brother of the petitioners and respondent no.7 herein.
The said payment was a partial payment made on 24.02.1989 and 15.05.1990.
It is thus sought to be contended that the balance amount has not been paid so far despite the stand that the requisite fund has been released by Krishi Utpadan Mandi Samiti.

5. Having regard to the facts of the case, we are of the opinion that directing the Special Land Acquisition Officer to pass a speaking order on the application dated 07.03.2020 (Annexure No.4)
would subserve the ends of justice.

6. Accordingly, the petition is disposed of with a direction to respondent no.2 to pass a speaking order on the application dated 07.03.2020 after hearing the petitioners and the private respondents as well as Krishi Utpadan Mandi Samiti and any other person claiming title in the subject land.

The aforesaid exercise shall be completed within a period of eight weeks from the date of communication of the instant order along with fresh representation, if any, and photo copy of the application dated 07.03.2020.

Order Date :- 14.5.2024 AKShukla/-
(Kshitij Shailendra, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.)
